summary: Standards: nothing builds atip with default features, so a break that only shows without 'validate' (an unused import, a cfg'd item still used) would pass CI: the probe's proof is cargo tree, which resolves but does not compile, and cargo test/clippy --workspace unify validate on through atip-check and canon-cli. I ran cargo clippy -p atip -p atip-probe --lib -- -D warnings (default features): clean today. Also not recorded anywhere: the brief's first Check, a byte comparison of canon and atip check output with a 0.34 binary; I ran it (baseline 4cf85cba vs f21e5451): 2210 canon cases (schema of every command, --help, each argument's domain with values inside/outside its bounds) are byte-equal (4 differ only because both binaries wrote into one directory; equal in fresh directories), and the atip check L0/L1 reports of canon differ only in time-derived data (timestamps, cursors, digests of them), with no verdict differing. Blast radius: the differential test admits_answers_as_the_validator_does takes about 250 s in a debug build.
